## Brainstorm

- *Where does Ivar's story begin?* Ivar has to be somewhere out of the way, so that he was hidden from Adrithyr for some amount of time, he lives a life there before he is attacked by assassins. This is his call to action. He lives in a small town called Rookswood just to the north of the Greenpeak Mountains.
	- *What does he do there?* He works somewhere that isn't physical labor to show the change from kind young man into a hardened adult warrior. He has a mentor Bajurn, a white dragonborn adventurer that stays in the village once every few months. While there Bajurn trains him with a sword and some of the other village kids as well.
